messages:
Ethan (eng-manager): Morning — I start next Monday as manager for the Infra team. Can someone share a compact first-week agenda + a 30/60/90 template I can use? Also heads-up: laptop swap and Okta group access might be needed. Thanks!

Leah (People Ops): Congrats Ethan! :tada: We'll DM you the formal packet but here's a lightweight first-week sprint plan + quick 30/60/90 skeleton. Also cc'ing Jordan from IT for device/access.

Leah (People Ops): First-week sprint plan (rough):
1) Day 0: Preboarding — paperwork, account invites
2) Day 1: Exec intro + HR orientation (AM), team kickoff (PM)
3) Day 2: System access + infra walkthrough
4) Day 3: 1:1s with direct reports
5) Day 4: Product/service deep dive
6) Day 5: Plan week 2 priorities + set 30/60/90 goals
Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/manager-first-week

Carlos (HR): FYI policy/doc access is in the People Ops drive — you'll get view/edit perms. For 30/60/90 here's a short template you can paste into Notion:
```
30 days: learn codebase, meet team, OSS checklist
60 days: own small project, improve onboarding docs
90 days: deliver first project, set roadmap for team
```
Happy to review a draft.

Jordan (IT): @Ethan I'll queue a laptop reimage for you. Can you confirm preferred hardware (MacBook Pro 16 / Linux ThinkPad)? Also added Okta group 'eng-infra' request form: `https://okta.redwood.internal/request?group=eng-infra` — fill and I'll approve.

Ethan (eng-manager): Thanks all. MacBook Pro 16 + 64GB preferred. Quick Q: who should I loop for Dedicated capacity onboarding and per-route dashboards?

Leah (People Ops): For Dedicated onboarding, ping @Maya (Platform PM) and @Carlos for any compliance docs. For dashboards, @Ava (Observability) owns console access.

Maya (Platform PM): Happy to run a 30-min dedicated onboarding with you on Tue. I'll send calendar invite. Agenda: high-level infra, SLA expectations, routing policies.

Ava (Observability): I'll add you to the console view role. Expect an invite from `console@redwood.ai`. Also suggest enabling budget alerts in the first week.

Ethan (eng-manager): Awesome. Also any recommended 1:1 icebreaker questions for the first week?

Leah (People Ops): Quick 1:1 prompts: what motivates you, biggest blocker today, one thing you'd change in onboarding, preferred feedback cadence. Keep it 30 min.

Carlos (HR): Also remember to schedule a benefits walkthrough with me before EOD Friday.

Jordan (IT): Ethan, ping me once you fill the Okta form. I'll also provision VPN and corp Slack channels (#infra-team).

Leah (People Ops): Sending you a Notion template and a short checklist in DM. If you want, I can pair with you to tailor the 30/60/90 for infra metrics (latency, cost, reliability) — we have examples from other managers.

Ethan (eng-manager): That would be great, thanks Leah. One last thing — any existing onboarding evals or prompt sets to baseline infra-related LLM workloads? (want to set quality metrics early)

Maya (Platform PM): We have a short eval pack in the repo `infra/evals/onboarding-baseline` — share access once you have code repo perms.

Leah (People Ops): Great! tagging thread as resolved for now. Reply here if anything blocks before Monday. :wave:
